fact: The Education Sector Plan 2020-2029 states that the SIGE is run by the DGESP with UNESCO support and fed by questionnaires in an annual collection campaign, with a high share of schools' data carried over from the previous year, and plans to enrich it and review the questionnaires; ESIGAPE, AFD-financed under PNEDU, is a teacher administration (presence) and pedagogical follow-up application at test-version stage in October 2019, and UNICEF's EduTrac, for school-level data on teacher presence and school functioning, was paused when the plan was written.
title: Plan sectoriel de l'éducation 2020-2029 de la République centrafricaine
